description: Refactor the Request and Response constructors across all example applications to improve consistency and maintainability. Update the constructor patterns in the example codebase to follow standardized practices while preserving existing functionality.
functional_requirements: Update Request constructor usage in all example applications to use a consistent initialization pattern
Update Response constructor usage in all example applications to follow standardized response building practices
Ensure all refactored examples maintain their original functionality and behavior
Apply consistent error handling patterns where applicable in the constructor refactoring
